notes: an outstanding proposal on a tally, keyed by tally id (story 03)
`changes` is what differs from the previous offer — story 03 step 3 wants exactly what changed, nothing else
`inForce` is null while a tally is still forming; on an open tally it carries the terms that keep working while an offer is pending (path C)

`superseded` is path A: two proposals fully signed, and the LATER-DRAFTED one governs. Precedence follows the proposal's own version order, not signature arrival — docs/architecture.md § Offer semantics
a counter is a new proposal, never an edit: the app must not present it as changing a live agreement
